name: wardrobe
description: Connect Codex to your Garderobe wardrobe: today's board, outfit recommendations, inventory, laundry and receipted wardrobe commands through the Garderobe MCP server and its own OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Read today's outfit board, ask for validated recommendations, browse the inventory and laundry, and make routine changes (choosing from the board, laundry pickup and return, trip packing, wear and wash reports) with a receipt and undo. Everything else is sent to the owner as a proposal to confirm in the Garderobe app.
defaultPrompt: Use Wardrobe to show me today's outfit board.
Use Wardrobe to suggest three outfits for tomorrow.
